text: 那生物俯冲了一小段，用武器全力轰击伯纳德，随后滑翔离去。
你冲到伯纳德身旁。他躺在地上，双眼圆睁，眼睑和脸上结满冰霜。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 634
text: The creature makes a shallow dive and blasts Bernard with the full force of its weapon before gliding away.
You rush to Bernard, where he lies on the ground. His eyes are wide and caked with ice.
